issue.title: test_hint_mode_renders_timestamp_file_hints_before_body_hints fails: rendered turn omits the prompt.py file hint

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Fails every serial run, not only under xdist. Observed in sase tool run check 3acd4d900f214c6830bc663849aed9dd, then again with .venv/bin/python -m pytest on this single node on 092fd1db05, and earlier on a10a6c6035 with the scope-sweep diff stashed. The assertion wants '[3] src/prompt.py' in the rendered turn. The render is AGENT PROMPT "Launch from [3] at src/raw.py" plus AGENT CHAT "Final response body", with no prompt.py hint line. tests do not import sase.agent.scope_sweep. This is a different node and a different symptom from sase-1hy (that one is test_hinted_raw_prompt_moves_to_identity_and_keeps_its_markers adding a duplicate file hint). Discovered while landing sase-1i4, not from a child PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP.

issue.creation_reason: sase-1i4 landing's just check reported this hint render failure as NEW. It fails serially on current master and on the tree with the scope diff stashed, so it is not caused by the agent-scope epic.

payload.description: Adjacent raw-prompt hint failure on a different node and symptom
